description: This file defines the Opencart\System\Library\Url class, which provides URL generation and rewriting functionalities within the OpenCart system. It includes methods for constructing URLs, adding rewrite mechanisms, and managing URL parameters.

classes.name: Url
classes.description: A class for handling URL generation, rewriting, and parameter appending within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL object with a base URL.

methods.name: addRewrite
methods.description: Adds a URL rewrite method to the URL system, which should implement a 'rewrite' callable method.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Generates a URL string based on the specified route, arguments, and JavaScript flag, applying rewrite methods if any are registered.
